issuer: the county driver licensing offices (on Oahu, the City and County of Honolulu Customer Services Department)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on honolulu.gov, the county that licenses Oahu: the driver's licence FAQ gives the fee as $20.00 for a 4-year licence (stated for renewal; it is the only licence fee the pages state, and it is held) and says a provisional licence converts to a full one at 17 after six months; the State ID page gives the card at $40, good for 8 years. The Hawaii Revised Statutes on capitol.hawaii.gov refused the request behind a captcha, so the statute's terms by age weren't read; Hawaii's other counties issue under the same law and their own fee pages weren't read.

sources.title: City and County of Honolulu, Driver's License FAQ
sources.said: The fee is $20.00 for a 4 year-license. ... To convert your provisional to a full license, you must be at least 17 years old and must have held the provisional license for at least six months.

sources.title: City and County of Honolulu, State ID
sources.said: It costs $40 ... The state ID is good for 8 years and expires on your birthday.
